gameplan.summary: Dominate early game with Q gank threat. Snowball kills before falling off at 3 items.
gameplan.win_condition: Gank lanes early, get ahead, and use Insec kick in teamfights to displace carries.
gameplan.early_game: Q → Q2 for execute. W to sustain. E to slow and shred armor. Invade enemy jungle at level 2.
gameplan.positioning: Stay mobile. Insec kick: Q target, ward jump behind, R to kick into team.

hecarim.tips: He outduels you at level 6. Invade early before he scales. Take Ignite for duels.
hecarim.power_shift: He outscales in sustained fights. Win through early ganks and objective control.

vi.tips: She has point-and-click CC. Don't fight her in her jungle at level 6. Invade at level 2.
vi.power_shift: Even early. She scales better. Win through early snowball before 20 minutes.

graves.tips: He outduels you at all stages post level 3. Avoid 1v1s. Win through ganking while he farms.
graves.power_shift: He wins all 1v1s. Win through superior ganks and objective setup.

amumu.tips: Invade him freely — he has no early dueling. Steal his camps. Counter-gank his ganks.
amumu.power_shift: You win early; he wins teamfights at 6. Shut him down before he gets ult.

kindred.tips: Contest her marks to deny stacks. Invade before she gets 4 marks. Don't fight inside her ult.
kindred.power_shift: She outscales at 4+ marks. Win before she reaches scaling threshold.
